_recipe.title: Launch film 16:9
_recipe.when: Calm ElevenLabs / Apple-style launch film (35-50s) for an AI, audio, SaaS or design product.
beats: Hook: the orb breathes in, "Meet [PRODUCT]." plus the promise. Quiet confidence, no shouting.
Rhythm: three short kinetic lines: input, action, result.
Demo: a real prompt typed into the product, the cursor clicks, the result appears.
Feel it: the waveform plays while the line lights up word by word.
Proof: one hard number (speed, accuracy, scale) with a meter.
Range: three capabilities as big dimming lines (no cards).
Who it's for: the audiences, one line.
CTA: the closing promise as a headline, then a quiet "Try [PRODUCT] →" link.
Logo: silent sign-off with name and tagline.
copyTips: Light type and one blue accent: put *accent* on the product name or the single word that matters, never on two things in one beat.
The demo prompt must be something a real user would type (under ~80 characters) and the result must be what the product really returns.
No sound product? Replace the wave beat with a second prompt demo or a list with style "lines"; keep the calm rhythm.
Say every number as words ("seventy-five milliseconds"); the screen shows "75ms".
Night version: --theme studio-dark. Vertical cut for Reels: --format reel (it stays under 60s).

scenes.say: Meet [PRODUCT]. [THE ONE-LINE PROMISE], made for the way you already work.
scenes.headline: Meet *[PRODUCT]*.

scenes.say: Describe what you want in plain words, press generate, and [PRODUCT] builds it for you in seconds.
scenes.label: Describe it
scenes.prompt: [A REAL REQUEST A USER WOULD TYPE]

scenes.say: Every detail lands exactly where you want it, every single time.
scenes.label: [OUTPUT] · [STYLE]

scenes.say: [SEVENTY-FIVE] milliseconds from your idea to the finished result.
scenes.label: from idea to *result*

scenes.say: Built for [AUDIENCE ONE], [AUDIENCE TWO], and everyone in between.
scenes.headline: [AUDIENCE ONE], [AUDIENCE TWO]
